LanguageData.RavenDecoy_Dummy.label: [Raven] Decoy Dummy
LanguageData.RavenDecoy_Dummy.description: A lifelike dummy simulating a Raven soldier. With a built-in electronic signal simulator, enemy AI will identify it as a high-threat armed unit (turret).\n\nIt is equipped with a harmless mock gun, constantly "attacking" to draw enemy fire.
LanguageData.RavenDecoy_Dummy_Gun.label: [Raven] Decoy Signal Emitter
LanguageData.RavenDecoy_Dummy_Gun.description: A mock weapon built into the dummy, firing harmless signal flares.
LanguageData.RavenDecoy_Dummy_Bullet.label: [Raven] Mock Signal
